drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel:

Attached is Defendant’s revised response. To address your concerns, Defendant has revised the response to state that it will produce responsive, non-privileged documents on a rolling basis and will provide a privilege log that is specific and compliant. Defendant has also removed the general reservation language.

As to scope, Defendant will identify any requests it contends are overbroad in its response so the parties can discuss narrowing in a targeted way. If you would like, we can schedule a short call after you review the revised objections to see whether any requests can be narrowed by agreement.

Best,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: GENERAL OBJECTIONS. edits.text: PRODUCTION. Subject to the foregoing objections, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents on a rolling basis.

edits.text: PRIVILEGE LOG. Documents withheld on privilege or work-product grounds are identified in a privilege log that is intended to be specific and compliant with the applicable rules.
